name: Card Stack Carousel
description: Draggable 3D stack of image cards. Swiping the top card past a threshold flings it aside and sends it to the back of the stack with a perspective flip.
contents: Stack of cards, each with tag pill, accent dot, image, title and subtitle
behavior: Pointer drag moves and tilts the top card and fades it slightly
Releasing past the threshold flings the card out, then returns it to the back of the stack
Releasing below the threshold snaps the card back
Cards behind are offset in depth and vertical position
editableByProps: Number of cards and all text, images and accent colors
Card size, stack depth and offsets, swipe threshold and speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card text colors or border
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the article element in the cards map
isAnimating branch inside the cards map

fixed: Root fills the viewport height, centers the stack and paints bodyBg. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Listens for pointerup on window while mounted and removes it on unmount
